Use non-cancelled lines only. Each line net is quantity times unitPoints minus that line's fixed lineRebate (once per line, not per unit). Sum those nets. Deduct an order rebate of 10% of that sum. Apply 5% tax to the post-order-rebate amount, rounding the tax to the nearest integer with exact halves rounded upward. Only tax is rounded. Add the untaxed, undiscounted deliveryPoints last. Preserve included line IDs in source order.

SOURCE_JSON
{
  "lines": [
    {
      "id": "U-7",
      "quantity": 3,
      "unitPoints": 240,
      "lineRebate": 30,
      "cancelled": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U-2",
      "quantity": 2,
      "unitPoints": 175,
      "lineRebate": 0,
      "cancelled": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U-5",
      "quantity": 4,
      "unitPoints": 999,
      "lineRebate": 1,
      "cancelled": true
    }
  ],
  "deliveryPoints": 75
}
END_SOURCE_JSON
